activeNote: Archived tasks 60-87 are treated as completed runtime foundations. This batch focuses on the missing Rust execution spine, runtime bridge, tool pipeline, memory and knowledge integration, reliability, and security before Sub-Agent expansion.

implementationNotes.foundationComplete: Story 43.1-49.4 in task-archived-1.json are reusable foundations and must not be rebuilt in this batch.
implementationNotes.integration: This batch is about connecting existing frontend runtime models to a real backend execution layer.
implementationNotes.backendRequired: Anything involving real execution, persistence, streaming, tools, permissions, knowledge retrieval, audit, or recovery must land in src-tauri/src/agent and Tauri commands.
implementationNotes.deferred: Business pilots, skill ecosystem work, and advanced multi-agent behavior stay out of the critical path until the main Agent loop is stable.
